notes.title: New Release! Get ZHive for $1.79 (-40%)
notes.content:
Hello Everyone

We have launched another wallet friendly game...Zhive!

Zhive is a small and simple strategy game where you command the undead on the map by selecting the areas where you want them to spawn and then direct them to a target area. But be careful, think strategically. The soldiers are well equipped and can decimate your minions with ease. Don't let them roam around, they could restock and find the survivor!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017571/110f5f3f7069ae9cbfabe596cf19ef9930b577e5.gif[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1119530/ZHIVE/

notes.title: New Release! Get ORC RAID for $3.50 [30% launch discount]
notes.content:
Hello Everyone.

We have released a new game! Orc Raid is a first person shooter where you fight tons enemies coming at you. It features a small story mode and the classic survival mode to rank via online leaderboards.

It has.... blood splashing everywhere!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017571/1f4a1404ae5e619b318cb7b7f60e51df5edc5e3c.gif[/img]

Did I mention it has flying bodyparts?

We hope you can support us with your purchase so we can keep raising the quality bar so one day, we can produce a game that will forever be remembered. 

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: New Game! "Dragon Chase" is now available! [30% Off]
notes.content:
Hello Everyone

We present you another wallet friendly game!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017571/12778fd3b1a12f568afb01ab807460b43d6f7ab3.gif[/img]

notes.title: Happy Autumn Sale! and check out a new game!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

We wish you a happy autumn sale and that you buy so many games that you won't be able to finish them this lifetime :)

In other news, we have released another wallet friendly game! [b]Time Splatter is available for $0.60[/b]..... But what is a Time Splatter? How do you eat it? [gif below]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017571/674882d078679411cffcc2fc5a98ec15d7ef96f2.gif[/img]

Time splatter is a small episodic rail shooter game where our protagonist, after touching an ancient monolith, is transported to the times where the black plague transformed people into zombie like creatures and knights protected the land. [Another gif below....]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017571/80c380c8f250ef2aa122d59203415ba09b79edf5.gif[/img]

At launch, only chapter 1 will be available, but we plan to release two more chapters... for free. If the game does well, there are concepts for another three, but lets not get ahead hehe. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/949530/Time_Splatter/

We hope you can support us with your purchase and keep helping us making games. We are hoping to step up the level of our games and bring you better and larger experiences early next year. But you, mighty players are the ones that will make this possible with your purchases and reviews. 

Check out our other games.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/904130/Defense_Abominations/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/846010/Visceral_Cubes/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/649450/Deadly_Escape/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/618610/Endless_Horde/

As always thanks for playing!

PD. We just sorted a couple problems we had that made development difficult. Expect to see content updates for several games soon.

notes.title: UPDATE #2 - Zombie Desperation is 40% off! Over 100,000 zombies killed!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32262387/49b2094c7bd90ad20c15435d323368d6c87d11e5.jpg[/img]

[h1]Zombie Desperation v1.1.38 is now online[/h1]

[h1]Bug fixes and Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Collectibles.[/b] There are now hidden "flash drives" in every map. Shoot a  certain area for the pickups to pop in. They will unlock files with data from the now deceased people of the game world, read them altogether to flesh out the story of the game, similar to the leftover notes in survival games. 
[*][b]New Achievements.[/b] Two new achievements have been added. Unlock them by collecting the flash drives.
[*][b]Archives Menu.[/b] Read the info contained in the flash drives.
Currently there are only 8 files, but there will be more in the future.
[*][b]PlayerStats.[/b] Players will now be able to check out detailed data about their performance, such as kills with every weapon. Useful to keep track of the achievement counters and to see other interesting stuff.
[*][b]Small Bug Fixes.[/b]
[*][b]Balancing Changes[/b]
[/list]

[h1]Incoming New Stuff/Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]New Items.[/b] Weapons and new defensive gadgets.
[*][b]New types of crosshairs[/b]
[*][b]Textures Fix.[/b] Several linux players have reported black textures in the deepest layer of the background graphics.
[/list]

[h1]Words from the devs[/h1]
Although small, we hope you enjoyed the game. By playing, you are contributing to make the world a safest place....once there is a zombie apocalypse... look forward to the next updates.

Join our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/ominousgaminggroup] Steam Group[/url] and like our [url=https://www.facebook.com/OminousEntertainment/] Facebook[/url] page, there will be several giveaways early next month! We have recently started to promote both sites, so there is barely anyone, cough cough [b]free keys[/b] almost warranted. Also check out our latest game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/846010/Visceral_Cubes/] Visceral Cubes[/url] if you have the chance.

And as always, thank you for your support!

notes.title: UPDATE #1
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32262387/ec2718b839933e5ec5f569a8c644d152190bdd4d.gif[/img]

[h1]Zombie Desperation v1.0.28 is now online[/h1]

[h1]Bug fixes and Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Flamethrower.[/b] This new weapon will be available on every level. The flames will stay in the map for a few seconds, continuously killing the zombies in that spot. [b]Smartly used to block spawns for a little while.[/b]
[*][b]Armored Zombie Headshot.[/b] You can no longer headshot armored zombies.
[*][b]Gutshot.[/b] You can no longer headshot bleeders(the monster in the gif), instead you need to shoot it in the gut for a "gutshot".
[*][b]Stacking Ammo.[/b] Picking two weapons of the same type will now stack the ammo.
[*][b]New spawn.[/b] A new zombie spawn has been added to the lobby level. Only 3 were working. Because of this, the difficult in that level will be increased.
[*][b]AdrenalineFix.[/b] Fixed a bug related to the adrenaline where the zombies were "teleporting".
[*][b]IceGrenadeFix.[/b] Fixed a bug where the frozen zombies appeared somewhere else after being frozen.
[*]Several other minor bug fixes and gameplay balancing changes.
[/list]

[h1]Incoming New Stuff/Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]New Items.[/b] Weapons and new defensive gadgets.
[*][b]Collectibles.[/b] Find collectibles to unlock documents with info about the game background story.
[*][b]PlayerStats.[/b] Players will be able to see some gameplay info such as the kills they have done with every weapon.
[*][b]New achievements[/b]
[*][b]New types of crosshairs[/b]
[*][b]Textures Fix.[/b] Several linux players have reported black textures in the deepest layer of the background graphics.
[/list]

[h1]Words from the devs[/h1]
The flamethrower weapon was intended for a later update but we added it on this one as it was impeding the players to get all the achievements. Sorry for the trouble. Players asked, players served.

And as always, thanks for your support!

notes.title: Zombie Desperation is now available... 40% off!
notes.content:
Another small horror experience has been unleashed, we hope you enjoy Zombie Desperation! 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32262387/4f469a1c2ea5e7efd2425a0f0ef4ce360a75946e.gif[/img]

ZD is a port from a mobile game originally released in 2011. It was a good hit back these days, however we had to take it down as there was no one to support it back then. 

Now, like a zombie (ironically) it comes back with some of the features that the platform has to offer, such as leaderboards and achievements. Some of the graphics have been improved to stand up to the challenge of time and now with better performance, more fluid action will take place.

We hope you'll be able to get enough fun out of the 1 USD you will spend for the game, and if you don't, there will be free content in the future. [b]Oh yeah there is a launch discount, grab the game while its hot.[/b]

Don't hesitate to post about any bug or issue you find on the bugs thread.

[h1]Incoming New Stuff[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]New Items.[/b] Weapons and new defensive gadgets.
[*][b]Balancing.[/b] Some weapons and enemies will be revisited to make the game more enjoyable.
[/list]

And as always, thanks for your support!
